title: Integrative immunoinformatics and structural modeling for the rational design of a multi-epitope vaccine candidate against human cytomegalovirus.
authors: Emmanuel, Owona Pascal; Sandrine, Mengue Ngadena Yolande; Claude, Bilanda Danielle; Ogunlakin, Akingbolabo Daniel; Ronald, Bidingha A Goudani; Desire, Dzeufiet Djomeni Paul; Aziz, Tariq; Aljumaa, Maha A; Alkhatib, Shaza N; Sagini, Hanan Abdulrahman
one_liner_zh: 该文用免疫信息学与结构建模设计巨细胞病毒多表位疫苗，虽涉及分子模拟但与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: Human cytomegalovirus (CMV) is a globally widespread pathogen associated with significant morbidity in immunocompromised individuals. Despite its clinical importance, no licensed vaccine is currently available. This study aimed to design a rational multi-epitope vaccine candidate targeting CMV using an integrative approach combining immunoinformatics and structural biology. Viral proteins were screened to identify epitopes with high affinity for B cells, cytotoxic T cells (CTLs), and helper T cells (HTLs) using the Immune Epitope Database (IEDB). Selected epitopes were filtered according to their antigenicity and toxicity and then assembled into a chimeric construct incorporating an immunostimulatory adjuvant. The designed vaccine was evaluated for its physicochemical properties, validated by Ramchandran and ERRAT analyses. Molecular modeling demonstrated strong and stable interactions with key innate immunity receptors, including TLR7 and TLR9, interactions confirmed by molecular dynamics simulations. In silico immune simulation predicted a robust and durable immune response, characterized by high levels of IgM and IgG, as well as significant activation of CD4 + and CD8 + lymphocytes and innate immunity components. These results highlight the potential of the proposed multi-epitope construct as a promising vaccine candidate against HCMV. However, experimental validation is essential to confirm its immunogenicity, safety, and translational applicability.
abstract_zh: 人巨细胞病毒（CMV）是一种全球广泛传播的病原体，与免疫功能低下个体的显著发病率和死亡率相关。尽管其具有临床重要性，但目前尚无获许可的疫苗可用。本研究旨在通过结合免疫信息学与结构生物学的整合方法，设计一种针对CMV的合理多表位疫苗候选物。利用免疫表位数据库（IEDB）筛选病毒蛋白，以识别对B细胞、细胞毒性T细胞（CTLs）和辅助T细胞（HTLs）具有高亲和力的表位。根据抗原性和毒性对选定的表位进行过滤，随后组装成包含免疫刺激佐剂的嵌合构建体。对所设计的疫苗进行了理化性质评估，并通过Ramachandran和ERRAT分析进行验证。分子建模显示其与关键先天免疫受体（包括TLR7和TLR9）存在强且稳定的相互作用，这些相互作用通过分子动力学模拟得到确认。计算机免疫模拟预测了强劲且持久的免疫反应，其特征为高水平的IgM和IgG，以及CD4+和CD8+淋巴细胞及先天免疫成分的显著激活。这些结果凸显了所提出的多表位构建体作为抗HCMV有前景疫苗候选物的潜力。然而，实验验证对于确认其免疫原性、安全性和转化适用性至关重要。
